message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly sought firing geometry by accelerating and descending toward the closing, nearly reciprocal Team B formation, then shifted to reducing post-launch exposure through a sustained hard-right command after its ammunition count fell and its missile appeared, amid an opposing B0200 launch in the same exchange.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly sought to remain offensive long enough to obtain firing geometry by sustaining the accelerating, descending head-on closure after A0100 broke right; once its own ammunition decreased and missile appeared, it began commanding a right offset, consistent with reducing direct exposure after launch."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly sought firing geometry by accelerating and descending toward the closing, nearly reciprocal Team B formation, then shifted to reducing post-launch exposure through a sustained hard-right command after its ammunition count fell and its missile appeared, amid an opposing B0200 launch in the same exchange.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly sought to remain offensive long enough to obtain firing geometry by sustaining the accelerating, descending head-on closure after A0100 broke right; once its own ammunition decreased and missile appeared, it began commanding a right offset, consistent with reducing direct exposure after launch.
